scraped.title: Skills survey among Portuguese justice civil servants
scraped.subtitle: Conducting a skills survey among Portuguese justice civil servants to assess the needs and levels of competencies and identify potential gaps and training needs
scraped.description: Following the drafting of the skills assessment for SDG. The OECD and the Government of Portugal have undertaken to run a survey to map the skills gap of policy makers in planning SDG policies. To this end, OECD had mandated ICON instiute to design, administer, analyse and…
body: Following the drafting of the skills assessment for SDG. The OECD and the Government of Portugal have undertaken to run a survey to map the skills gap of policy makers in planning SDG policies. To this end, OECD had mandated ICON instiute to design, administer, analyse and report on the skills situation in the Government of Portugal. The result of this survey will allow the OECD to design a capacity building plan suited to the needs and existing skills of Portugal.
